title: Session: 2.40.0 My roles review
objective: Review the 2.40.0 My roles page on owner-authorized staging: members and guests sign in and pick their own roles from the published role menu, TaruBot applies them in the background, and people who lose every access role lose channel-opening menu roles. No migration. The changelog channel gets this release's update post. Preserve one DevBot writer; production requires separate readiness and GitHub approval.
user: Review the exact release source/digest and backups before authorizing the existing staging target's upgrade; it adds no migration, and going back to 2.39.0 needs no restore.
Afterwards check the test guild's changelog channel for one 'TaruBot updated to v2.40.0' post with this release's note, or a paused changelog.post in /sync status while effects are off.

With TaruBot lacking Administrator, publish a throwaway test category, sign in as a test member and a test guest on a phone and a desktop, and save, change and clear picks on My roles; check the banners, Discord's audit-log reason and that Background work shows 'A member'.

Check a first sign-in by an account that never authorized the application, a timed-out account (view only), a lobby account (refused), and that revoking a test guest removes a channel-opening test role but keeps a cosmetic one. Approve production only after its own healthy baseline.
assistant: Before release, review the credential-free harness as officer, member, guest and timed-out member from 320 to 1440 px, including --state-roles=queued|blocked|failed|skipped|expired, and run the full suite with disposable PostgreSQL and the documentation site build.
Diagnose owner-reported results, preserve scope and record exercised verification separately from unverified live acceptance.
Perform no live host, token, database, Discord, environment or deployment operations. This plan grants no live-operation authorization.
bot: Run one DevBot instance under the staging profile, with effects initially paused and strict managed-database/test-guild guards.

Serve dashboard pages, the stylesheet, fonts and license notices from the same bot process only when web is enabled; admit officers, and Member or Guest holders while TaruBot lacks Administrator; require the session's form token and keep server reads scoped.

Apply My roles saves as roles.self jobs, one role at a time with an audit-log reason; keep role IDs out of results, logs and officer views, close changes still waiting after 7 days and delete finished ones after 30.
Queue one update post for each server whose changelog channel stored an older version, listing the notes since then; park it while effects are paused.
Expose database, Discord and writer-lease readiness; report 2.40.0, startup time and effect state without pinging members.
